quarterly_data.quarter: Skyverse Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Zhou Fannü (results briefing): Q1 2026 revenue was RMB 39,602.36 ten-thousand, up 34.63% year on year, which she attributed to progress in core technology, industrialisation and upgrades of each product series, with new products and upgraded existing products contributing more revenue. Board secretary Gu Kainan said the company will stay focused on high-end semiconductor quality-control equipment, push new and volume products toward more advanced nodes, and actively expand into overseas advanced-process and advanced-packaging markets on full product coverage, cost-performance and customised service, to keep revenue and order scale growing steadily.
